title: 5 killed, 11 injured as car collides with pickup in Punjab

title: Google CEO congratulates SpaceX; says: Still feels like science fiction

£8 coin bought at car boot sale may hide 192-year-old minting error
content: A team of researchers has thoroughly examined a distorted silver sixpence from 1834, uncovering unexpected manufacturing flaws. Through intricate 3D imaging, they revealed significant deformations and patterns that stray from regular wear. This peculiar state of the coin prompts a deeper look into the production methods of the steam-powered minting period. The analysis, combining advanced imaging and chemistry, sheds light on historical minting defects.

title: South Dakota ranch sees wildlife rebound after decade of grazing changes
content: In South Dakota, a ranching family has harnessed the power of rotational grazing and cutting-edge virtual fencing to rejuvenate their land's biodiversity. By allowing grasslands to rest between grazing sessions, they have significantly improved plant health and restored native ecology. This approach not only boosts wildlife populations, such as diverse bird species and larger mammals, but also streamlines cattle management with reduced labor.
